confidence_notes: I searched three times: one for the RBA rate and two for Saranda prices. Restaurant meal, beer and coffee anchors rest on aggregated price sources: Numbeo-style listings of about 265 ALL for a draft beer, 183 ALL for a cappuccino and 800 ALL for an inexpensive meal, plus a 2026 cost-of-living site. These sources disagree. A mid-range dinner for two ranged from about $15 to about $50, so I picked a value in between. Wine is based on a Saranda nightlife guide quoting 300-600 ALL per glass. I found no Saranda cocktail price. I set it from the beer price and from a Himara guide quoting 600-900 ALL for cocktails, which is a nearby coastal town. All accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge. I did not search for accommodation prices or inspect any listings. Saranda is a seasonal beach resort and July prices run above the annual averages, so accommodation is the least certain group. I skipped the third to fifth price searches, so the figures are thinner than the permitted search budget would allow.
comparable_city_reasoning: Southern Albanian Riviera resort town, priced between Albanian city averages and Greek Ionian island tourist prices in peak summer. Comparable to Ksamil, Himara and Vlore, with July peak-season uplift on accommodation and some venue prices.
